text:
sam: Heads up — we had repeated pod evictions from gpu-island-usw2 last night, CA kept scaling up new nodes in eu-west and cost spiked. Logs show pods couldn't schedule back because of node taints + our affinity. Anyone else see this?

maria: saw alerts at 03:12 UTC. CA: "scale up" decisions had candidate nodes in eu-west-1 only (region fallback).

joel: do we have cross-zone fallback enabled? should be region-aware.

infra-bot: Incident detected: repeated POD_EVICTION events on cluster redwood-prod-gpu at 2025-03-12T03:10:23Z — nodes drained by daemonset upgrade.

sam: right — sequence was: node drain for kernel patch -> taints applied (gpu:reserved:NoSchedule) -> kube-scheduler rebinds pods -> our pods have nodeAffinity: preferredDuringScheduling but no toleration for gpu:reserved so they got evicted, CA couldn't place in same AZ due to capacity -> fell back to other region per policy.

maria: can you paste pod spec? quick grep from last run:

sam: ```yaml
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "nvidia.com/gpu"
    operator: "Exists"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoreDuringExecution:
      - weight: 100
        preference:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            operator: In
            values: [us-west-2a, us-west-2b]
``` 

joel: ah — toleration key is wrong. kubelet taint is gpu:reserved not nvidia.com/gpu. So pods didn't tolerate and were evicted.

maria: that mismatch + overly strict zone affinity blocked rescheduling. Fix options:
- update toleration key to match taint
- relax nodeAffinity to allow same-region fallback
- add podTopologySpread / podAntiAffinity to avoid cross-zone cost

sam: agreed. I pushed a quick rollback to use toleration key `gpu:reserved` in the job template. Also adding toleration with operator Exists for both keys to be safe.

joel: longterm: we should standardize taint keys (infra-provisioning doc). Also adjust CA policy to prefer same-az before cross-region.

maria: raised doc PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/422

sam: cost note — estimate extra bill ~$1.2k for the two-hour span. tagging finance.

alex: noted, thx. Can infra add alert when CA scales to different region?

sam: will add CA webhook alert + per-tenant region shift metric. Patch in next deploy.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued for branch fix/taint-toleration-compat (CI passed).

maria: great. marking incident resolved but keeping monitoring for 24h :thumbsup:
